# Matthew Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old at the beginning of the story  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P19](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0019)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Rachel Lynde's husband  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Matthew is an odd-looking man with an ungainly figure, stooping shoulders, and long iron-gray hair. He has worn a full, soft brown beard since he was twenty years old. On formal occasions, he wears a white collar and his best suit of clothes.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)_

## Personality

Matthew is extremely shy, silent, and reclusive, dreading strange women and avoiding places where he might have to talk. Despite his timid nature, he is deeply kind-hearted, sympathetic, and quiet in his affection. He possesses a soft-hearted persistence when his mind is set on something, often quietly indulging those he loves.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c4 P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026), [v1 c24 P17](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0017)_

## Goals

- To adopt a boy to help with farm chores  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023)</sub>
- To provide for and support Anne Shirley's happiness and education  <sub>[v1 c3 P60](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0060), [v1 c25 P4](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0004), [v1 c25 P60](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0060)</sub>

## History

Matthew Cuthbert, an aging farmer living at Green Gables with his sister Marilla, decided to adopt an orphan boy to assist with farm work. Upon driving to the station, he discovered that an eleven-year-old girl, Anne Shirley, had been sent by mistake. Too shy to explain the error, Matthew brought her home and quickly became fond of her chatter and vibrant spirit, persuading Marilla to keep her. Throughout Anne's upbringing, Matthew acted as her indulgent ally, buying her a dress with puffed sleeves for Christmas and supporting her educational ambitions. As his health declined due to heart spells, he continued to work hard on the farm. After Anne graduated from Queen's Academy with top honors, Matthew died suddenly of a heart attack upon reading of the failure of the Abbey Bank, where his savings were kept.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c3 P60](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0060), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c25 P4](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0004), [v1 c25 P35](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0035), [v1 c30 P38](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0038), [v1 c36 P41](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0041), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)_

## Background by volume

- Son of a shy and silent father who founded the Green Gables homestead  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- Lived his entire life at Green Gables with his sister Marilla  <sub>[v1 c1 P7](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0007), [v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031)</sub>
- Suffered from heart trouble in his later years  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c30 P38](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0038)</sub>
